claims: Masters.com and the Masters app feature Amen Corner coverage from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET.
Masters.com and the Masters app feature Featured Groups coverage from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
Masters.com and the Masters app feature coverage of holes 4, 5, 6, 15, and 16.
Prime Video streams early round coverage on Thursday and Friday from 1-3 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ streams the final two rounds from noon to 7 p.m. ET on Saturday and Sunday.
ESPN App and ESPN+ stream early round action on Thursday and Friday.
Fubo offers access to CBS and ESPN coverage.
YouTube TV offers access to CBS and ESPN coverage.
Hulu+Live TV offers access to CBS and ESPN coverage.
The 2026 Masters Featured Groups/Holes coverage on Thursday-Friday is from 10 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET (approx.).
The 2026 Masters TV coverage on Thursday-Friday is on ESPN from 3 to 7:30 p.m. ET (approx.).
The 2026 Masters Featured Groups/Holes coverage on Saturday is from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET (approx.).
The 2026 Masters TV coverage on Saturday is on CBS from 2 to 7 p.m. ET (approx.).
The 2026 Masters Featured Groups/Holes coverage on Sunday is from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET (approx.).
The 2026 Masters TV coverage on Sunday is on CBS from 2 to 7 p.m. ET (approx.).
